light.best.quote: These orchids grow best with bright light to some sun, but no direct midday sun.

light.min.quote: A dark leaf indicates insufficient sunlight.

light.min.reason: 光をたくさん必要とするため、明るい日陰を下限とした

light.directSun.quote: Direct sun will burn the leaves.

temperature.minC.quote: The temperatures must be between 70 to 85 degrees F during the day and 55 to 60 degrees F at night.

temperature.idealC.quote: The temperatures must be between 70 to 85 degrees F during the day

watering.growing.quote: The medium should be allowed to dry completely between waterings.

watering.growing.reason: 水苔・バークがほぼ乾いてから与えるため「半分乾いたら」とした

watering.winter.reason: 出典に冬の記載がないため、室温が下がると水を吸う量が減ることから一段乾かし気味とした

tips.ja: 葉の色が濃い緑すぎるのは光不足。ちょうどよい光なら中くらいの緑。
tips.quote: A leaf with the right amount of sun is mid-green.

tips.ja: 10℃（50°F）より冷たい水や軟水器を通した水は使わない。
tips.quote: Do not use salt-softened water or water colder than 50 degrees F.
